svg.title: The share cooking with clean fuels rose faster than the share with electricity
svg.desc: Dot chart: The share cooking with clean fuels rose faster than the share with electricity: Access to electricity: 78.2% in 2000, 80.7% in 2005, 83.5% in 2010, 86.9% in 2015, 90.4% in 2020, 91.6% in 2023; Clean fuels for cooking: 47.8% in 2000, 52.1% in 2005, 56.7% in 2010, 63.9% in 2015, 71.3% in 2020, 74.5% in 2023.
